title: Allow a page size above 100 for exports
author: robin-fixture
body:
Our export script wants 500 tasks per request, but the API refuses any `pageSize` above 100.

Could the cap be raised, or made configurable per client? The README mentions a `Paging:MaxPageSize` setting, but changing it did not change the limit for us.

comments.author: dana-fixture
comments.body: There is an ADR about why the cap exists. Please read it before proposing a number; the answer may be paging in the export script instead.
